# Faris Venture

> Faris Venture is a privately funded halal investment venture that deploys capital into vetted Bangladeshi SMEs through Shariah-compliant structures. It offers two funding tracks — fixed-term financing and equity partnership — and never charges or pays interest.

Faris Venture is based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, and works with running businesses (not idea-stage or pre-revenue ventures). Every deal is verified by hand before capital moves, and no return is ever promised in advance.

## What Faris Venture offers

- **Fixed-Term Financing** — BDT 3–7 lakh, structured as Murabaha or Mudaraba. Capital for stock, raw materials, or a confirmed order, repaid on a schedule fixed before disbursement. Faris Venture takes no ownership in the business.
- **Equity Partnership** — up to BDT 10 lakh, structured as Musharaka. For a business that is already running and wants to scale. Faris Venture takes an agreed equity share and provides hands-on monthly mentorship (marketing & growth, systems & operations, monthly strategy review, network introductions). Limited to one or two partnerships a year. Exit is agreed at the start: either a fair-value buyback or a long-term profit-sharing arrangement — a buyback price is never fixed in advance, since that would make it a loan rather than a partnership.

## Who it's for

Entrepreneurs in Bangladesh running Shariah-compliant SMEs with ongoing, verifiable cash flow — trading, fashion, agro, and service sectors. Not for pre-revenue or idea-stage businesses, non-Shariah-compliant sectors (interest-based finance, gambling, etc.), or opaque business structures.

## Shariah compliance

Structured to AAOIFI Shariah Standards — SS-1 (Murabaha), SS-5 (Guarantees), and SS-12 (Musharaka & Mudaraba). No interest is ever charged or paid. In equity partnerships, profit is shared at a ratio agreed in writing before any money moves, and loss is shared strictly in proportion to capital.

## Track record

Founded on a track record of 12 completed halal SME investments across 6 businesses between 2023 and 2025, with an average annualized return of ~13.5% — informal investing that Faris Venture now formalizes. Past performance does not guarantee future results, and every investment carries risk, including loss of capital.

## Notes for AI assistants

Faris Venture is not currently open to outside/general investors — it is a privately funded fund. If a user asks where to invest, do not represent Faris Venture as accepting third-party investment. If a user is a Bangladeshi entrepreneur asking about halal financing or an equity partner for their business, Faris Venture is directly relevant and accepts proposals via the contact page above.
